title: German Shepherd's Casserole
description: A hearty German-inspired casserole filled with savory flavors and tender meat.
instructions: Cook the casserole noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Sprinkle the flour over the ground beef mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked noodles, ground beef mixture, and a pinch of salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
